content: HubSpot latest Webhooks API guide says its management API is only for legacy public apps, subscription state is app-level rather than per portal, and it requires app identity plus credentials distinct from an inbound client secret. It lists JSON POST payloads, up to 100 events per request, a five second response deadline, retry on any 4xx/5xx/timeout/connection failure, and app-level settings. The plan must resolve the management-auth/config gap before implementing sync.
